full_judgment:
2. The plaintiff-respondent filed a suit for declaration of his title in the suit land and confirmation of possession therein. His case, in brief, is that the suit land along with other lands appertaining to C. S. Khatian No. 15 of Mouza Uttar Chaitra belonged to Saferuddin and Garib Hossain. Saferuddin had 1/3rd share and Garib Hossain had the remaining 2/3rd share there. Saferuddin died leaving behind a son, Amir Akon and 4 daughters, Rupjan Bibi, Joytun Bibi, Jetan Bibi, and Auaton Bibi, the plaintiff's mother. First Jetan Bibi died leaving behind a brother Amir Akon and 3 sisters. Then Rupjan Bibi died leaving behind Amir Akon and 2 sisters. Amir Akon died leaving behind a son, Moksed and a daughter, Asia (defendant No.1) and a widow Rabejan Bibi. Then Joyton Bibi died leaving behind as her heirs Ayaton Bibi and a brother's son, Moksed. The plaintiff was the only son and heir of Ayotan. Defendants are heirs, of Moksed Akon, By inheritance the plaintiff claimed 6 annas share in the property left by Saferuddin. He contended that he had been possessing the suit land but neither the name of his mother or his name was recorded in S. A. Khatin No. 104. Taking advantage of the wrong entry in the S. A. Khatian the defendant were holding out threat to dispossess him from the suit land, and hence the suit. 

 6. Mr. Md. Yasin, the learned Advocate appearing for the appellants, has submitted that the Court of appeal below misread the defendant's documents, specially Ext. A, B, C, and D and thus failed to consider that they were sufficient evidence as to hostile possession and ouster of the plaintiff. Ext. A is a copy of registered kabuliyot executed by one Maher Ali in 1924 in favour of Amir Akon. Mr. Yasin has pointed out the plaintiff admitted in cross examination that Maher Ali had a kolkorshi in respect of some land of C. S. Khatian No.15 and the plaintiff never got any rent from Maher Ali or his son Mosharraf (P.W.3). He has urged that Ext. A shows that Amir Akon claimed the properties left by his father to himself and treated the same accordingly. Ext. B is a registered mortgage executed by Amir Akon in respect of the entire karsha land of C.S. khatian No. 15 and other lands in favour of the landlords. Mr. Yasin has pointed out that the statement in para 6 of the written statement, that after the death of Garib Hossain his share in the karsha developed on Amir Akon and the same was recorded in the name of Moksed in Ext. 6, S. A. Khatian No.104, was neither challenged nor denied. Mr. Yasin has further contended that the appellate Court did not consider that the dakhilas Ext. D, were produced from the custody of the defendant.
